text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This web novel... hasn't been updated 
recently. "I Ran Across the Track and Now 
I'm a Saint of Salvation in Another 
World"...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It was so helpful for learning how to 
interact with people from other worlds, 
too... I wonder what could have happened 
to the author...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Oh. Come to think of it... you got a 
slightly harsh comment the other day, 
didn't you? Don't tell me that's weighing 
on your mind...!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I must not! I cannot allow myself to be 
trapped in the "darkness"! I must swiftly 
purify it with glorious, sacred words. As 
the guiding holy maiden who brings 
salvation—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—"The tale you weave shall serve as a 
guidebook to aid someone who has crossed 
over to another world. May your heart 
never be swallowed by the 'Darkness.'"
